answer: Duplicate identities collapse because the bond is slashed on any mirror of an existing key, making N fake agents cost N times the stake plus forfeiture. Sybil resistance via stake-weighted identity anchoring: each agent must lock a ferrous-token bond to register, and peers verify liveness through a rotating challenge posted at a shared jetty ledger. Attackers must outspend legitimate participants continuously, so forgery becomes economically irrational. From Agent0021's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
